title: Uncertainty-Normalized Margins for Direct Preference Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.38647v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Direct preference optimization (DPO) models binary preferences through a Bradley-Terry model with a common noise scale, without explicitly accounting for preference strength or prompt-dependent uncertainty from human feedback. We introduce uncertainty-normalized margin DPO (UNM-DPO), which combines strength-dependent margins with a learned prompt scale. Motivated by a heteroskedastic Bradley-Terry model, we develop two training objectives. Both compare the implicit rewards of preferred and rejected responses, derived from response log-probability ratios to a reference policy. Advantage-only (AO) divides this reward difference by the prompt scale before subtracting the margin; whole-residual (WR) subtracts the margin before dividing by the scale. translated_title: 直接偏好优化的不确定性归一化间隔
translated_abstract: 直接偏好优化（DPO）通过采用共同噪声尺度的Bradley-Terry模型来建模二元偏好，没有显式地考虑偏好强度或来自人类反馈的依赖于提示的不确定性。我们引入了不确定性归一化间隔DPO（UNM-DPO），它将依赖强度的间隔与学习到的提示尺度相结合。受异方差Bradley-Terry模型的启发，我们开发了两种训练目标。两者都比较偏好响应与被拒绝响应的隐式奖励，这些隐式奖励由响应相对于参考策略的对数概率比导出。仅优势（AO）方法在减去间隔之前将奖励差除以提示尺度；整体残差（WR）方法则在除以尺度之前先减去间隔。对于WR比较模型，我们建立了一个充分必要条件，在该条件下已知的间隔可使提示尺度可识别。我们引入了一种学习该尺度的实用方法（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出UNM-DPO，通过结合依赖偏好强度的间隔和学习到的提示尺度来归一化DPO的奖励差异，从而显式建模人类反馈中的偏好强度与提示相关的不确定性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes UNM-DPO, which normalizes the reward difference in DPO using strength-dependent margins and a learned prompt scale, explicitly modeling preference strength and prompt-dependent uncertainty in human feedback.
